name: day-trader-skill-india
description: 13 Claude skills for intraday trading on the Indian stock market (NSE/BSE, Zerodha Kite): pre-market briefing, Stocks-in-Play opening-range scanner, entry timer, exit planner, exact Zerodha charges, replay after charges, position sizer, risk manager, order executor (paper by default, never without your yes), news, bulk/block deals, a trade journal and a paper-trading autopilot.
